hooks.command:
# danfault:git-commit-block
cmd=$(jq -r '.tool_input.command // empty')
if echo "$cmd" | grep -qE '\bgit\s+commit(\s|$)'; then
  printf '%s\n' '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"deny","permissionDecisionReason":"git commit is blocked on this machine (danfault git-commit-block) - use the /commit skill instead (drafts a message to .git/claude-commit-message.txt, then hand the printed git commit -F <file> command to the user to run). To remove this, delete this git-commit-block entry from the PreToolUse array in ~/.claude/settings.json."}}'
fi
exit 0

# danfault:vault-reindex
# Reindex the vault holding the edited note, in the background; no-op outside every vault.
f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty')
[ -n "$f" ] && nohup uv run -q --project "$HOME/danfault/python/obsidian-mcp" obsidian-index --for-file "$f" >/dev/null 2>&1 &
exit 0
